{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in Arizona State University's doctoral religious studies program through the School of Historical, Philosophical and Religious Studies. We are excited that you are considering joining the ASU community. Here is some information to get you started on your journey:
Program description and admission requirements at: shprs.clas.asu.edu/graduate/religious-studies-phd
Religious studies graduate faculty at: graduate.asu.edu/index.php?q=graduate-faculty/degree/LARELIGPHD
Religious studies faculty research areas at: https://shprs.asu.edu/content/religious-studies-3
Religious studies placement record at: shprs.clas.asu.edu/graduate/recent-phds-and-placements
Please review these links closely, and contact me at Lindseyplaitjones@asu.edu with any additional questions you may have.
Sincerely,
Lindsey Plait Jones Graduate Program Coordinator School of Historical, Philosophical and Religious Studies College of Liberal Arts and Sciences
